meta.pos: noun; verb; adj.; adv.; adj.; noun

defs.def: the state of being physically relaxed and free from pain; the state of having a pleasant life, with everything that you need 舒服；安逸；舒适

ex.s: For those seeking both comfort and convenience, the Renaissance Los Angeles Airport Hotel is just a short drive away.
ex.t: 对于既追求舒适又讲究便利的人来说，洛杉矶机场万丽酒店只需短途车程即可到达。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 当其他人都睡了，我却在清醒中感到慰藉，我喜爱夜晚的宁静。

ex.s: “I’m a coach, an adviser, and a comforter, and that’s what it means to be a hospital teacher.”
ex.t: 正因如此，《作家文摘》本期致力于帮你弄清楚如何为你所写的任何类型的作品写出最好的结局。

ex.s: Walking at night-time is a great way to step out of your comfort zone.
ex.t: 夜间徒步是走出舒适区的好方式。

ex.s: Most people do physical exercise for comfort and pleasure.
I realised that by trying something new, I can have fun — even if it means stepping out of my comfort zone.
ex.t: 我意识到，通过尝试新事物，我可以获得快乐——即使这意味着走出舒适区。

ex.s: Get out of your comfort zone.
Two thirds of people aim to improve their comfort while at home.
ex.t: 三分之二的人希望提高居家的舒适度。

ex.s: So many of us have the belief that being comfortabel is the only state we will tolerate, and when we experience something outside of our comfort zone, we get impatient about the circumstances.
ex.t: 我们中的许多人都认为舒适是我们唯一能容忍的状态，而当我们经历舒适区之外的事情时，就会对这种处境失去耐心。

ex.s: She smiled at me and said if I needed help, she’d be right there, which I found quite comforting.
ex.t: 她对我微笑说如果需要帮助她就在那里，我觉得这很令人安慰。

ex.s: “It was extremely touching and comforting to know that somebody had taken the time to do that for my family.
ex.t: "得知有人花时间为我的家人这样做，真的非常感人，令人欣慰。

defs.def: a feeling of not suffering or worrying so much; a feeling of being less unhappy 安慰；慰藉；宽慰

ex.s: Perhaps we comfort ourselves with the knowledge that most of the lies we tell are “white lies”: little lies that we tell to protect others from the truth.
ex.t: 也许我们知道我们所说的大多数谎言都是“善意的谎言” ：我们说谎是为了保护他人免受真相的伤害。

ex.s: Anxious parents do what they can to comfort nervous and crying children.
ex.t: 焦虑的父母尽其所能安慰紧张和哭泣的孩子。

ex.s: Showing concern _______________________ Comforting people _______________________ 1 You ran for Head of the Student Committee but weren't elected.
She is a great source of comfort and guidance for them as they learn to live with the changes thrust upon them.
ex.t: 当他们学会忍受强加给他们的变化时，她是他们安慰和指导的重要来源。

ex.s: It was the only source of hope and comfort for a hundred future generations, setting on a voyage through an abyss of adversity.
ex.t: 这是一百个后代的唯一希望和安慰的源泉，踏上了穿越逆境深渊的旅程。

defs.def: a person or thing that helps you when you are suffering, worried or unhappy 令人感到安慰的人（或事物）
a thing that makes your life easier or more comfortable 舒适的设施（或条件）
